passage:
A phone update showed users how many hours they spent on each app. Jason was shocked to see how much time he spent watching short videos.
He had not planned to spend that much time. He only watched when waiting for the bus, before sleep, and during breaks. Small moments had added up.
Jason did not delete the app. Instead, he set a daily limit and moved it away from his home screen.
After one week, he read more and slept earlier.
The report did not scold him. It simply showed him himself.
Sometimes self-control begins with measurement. People cannot change a habit they cannot see.
